definitions.explanation: The act of calling out names one by one, as in a roll call or attendance check.

examples.japanese: {呼名|こめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧{呼名|こめい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{出欠|しゅっけつ}→出欠：09604_shukketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher called each name one by one to check attendance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{卒業生|そつぎょうせい}→卒業生：15284_sotsugyousei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{呼名|こめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: At the graduation ceremony, the names of graduates are called out.

notes:
Combines {呼|こ} (to call) and {名|めい} (name). Heard mostly at schools and ceremonies, such as the calling of graduates' names at a graduation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {呼名|こめい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to call out names

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{点呼|てんこ}→点呼：15724_tenko⟧: roll call — specifically checking attendance, often in military or organizational settings
- ⟦{呼称|こしょう}→呼称：12126_koshou⟧: designation, name — the usual word for what something is called; the "nominal size" of a part in engineering is ⟦{呼|よ}び→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧, as in ⟦{呼|よ}び→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦{寸法|すんぽう}→寸法：04311_sunpou⟧
- ⟦{名称|めいしょう}→名称：12031_meishou⟧: official name — the formal, fixed name of something
